item.title: Medical influencer Attia resigns post at CBS News after name included in multiple Epstein files
item.description: Attia was named last month by CBS News editor-in-chief Bari Weiss as a contributor to network programming.

item.title: Body of civil rights leader Jesse Jackson is to lie in state in South Carolina
item.description: Jackson died after battling a rare neurological disorder that affected his ability to move and talk.

item.title: World War II vet celebrates 103rd birthday with the MN National Guard
item.description: Don Halverson stays connected with his fellow service members, sometimes sharing a meal at his VFW club. Though these days he's often the only World War II vet in attendance.

item.title: Volunteers scour the desert for Nancy Guthrie despite authorities urging them to stop
item.description: Experts say volunteers can be helpful but should work under the direction of law enforcement.

item.title: Epstein sought to bring entourage of women on 2013 SpaceX visit
item.description: The visit is another example Epstein seeking to ingratiate himself with high-profile people.

item.title: WNBA says March 10 deadline needed for new CBA
item.description: NEW YORK (AP) — The WNBA told the players’ union that it needs to get a deal in place by March 10 to start the season on time at a virtual collective bargaining agreement negotiating session Monday, a person familiar with the discussions told The Associated Press. item.title: Governor orders flags at half-staff two days this week to honor Rev. Jesse Jackson
item.description: Gov. Tim Walz has ordered U.S. and state flags to be flown at half-staff Wednesday and Thursday to honor the life of civil rights leader Rev. Jesse Jackson who died Feb. 17

item.title: Rep. Angie Craig will bring son of deported Minnesota woman to state of union
item.description: Angel Silva, a Rosemount man, will be Rep. Angie Craig's guest at Tuesday's State of the Union address in Washington, D.C. Silva's mother, who had a work permit and was trying to obtain residency, decided to self deport after she was flown to Texas after she appeared at an immigration hearing

item.title: Hastings man sentenced to more than 16 years in prison for child sex abuse material
item.description: A Hastings man charged with three counts of child pornography was sentenced to more than 16 years in prison
